messages:
Tara (growth): Heads-up: planning a compact microlaunch to test a starter-credit + prompt-template combo. Quick sync? Goal: improve 7-day activation by ~8%.
Mike (content): Love it. Timeline?
Tara (growth): Proposed: week of Apr 11. Channels: launch posts, a short live workshop, and onboarding nudges. We'll A/B: standard credit vs credit+template pack.
Juhi (ops): For inbound routing, should we funnel new signups who claim credits into the 'starter-workshop' webinar slot? Live session could boost activation.
Sam (product-marketing): Yes — plus a warm nurture for those who download templates. Add a CTA in launch posts: "Claim free credit + prompt pack".
Mike (content): Copy idea: "Build with Redwood — free credit + 3 starter prompts to bootstrap your first agent." Short and concrete.
Tara (growth): Metrics we care about: first-5-calls activation, 7-day retention, webinar attendance, and convert-to-paid at 14 days. Ops asks: can Eng produce a small, token-light template pack? @Juhi can you coordinate with Eng-ML for a 3-pack? We also need a tiny eval prompt set for regressions.
Juhi (ops): Will do. I'll request a 3-template set + a smoke eval. Pinging Olga for model / quantization reco.
Olga (eng-ml): Happy to help. Recommend quantized gpt-small-qa for the pack — low cost and good for short templates. I can export a tested 3-pack by Tue.
Sam (product-marketing): Landing page experiment: Variant A single CTA + claim flow. Variant B shows 3 micro-use-cases and template previews. Track with distinct UTM and cohort flag.
Tara (growth): :thumbsup: I'll draft launch posts, the workshop outline, and the onboarding nudge copy. Also need 2 short benchmark blurbs for the release thread: latency & cost delta for cached batching vs baseline.
Mike (content): I'll write the benchmark blurb and short social hooks. Plan: 30-min live workshop + 60-min office hours the week after.
Juhi (ops): Routing rule proposal: new signups who use >50 tokens within the first hour => tag as high-interest and route to SDR queue. Others go to automated 7-day template drip.
Sam (product-marketing): Can we gate the template claim with a 1-question use-case form? Helps classify leads without fricition.
Tara (growth): Keep it minimal (one short field). OK team — sync Thurs 10am PT? If no objections I'll create calendar and a focused channel #microlaunch-spark.
Mike (content): Works for me.
Olga (eng-ml): Works for me.
Juhi (ops): Works — I'll start the Eng-ML request and sketch the routing rules.
